title: One Time header CTA spacing corrective packet

reasons: Operator requested a visible One Time public page header, button, spacing, and mobile CTA correction.
Operator also requested a One Time bot knowledge guardrail about portal access not being available yet.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time communication bot knowledge base
likely_external_provider_blockers: No WhatsApp, Telegram, email, access, payment, DNS, or credential mutation is approved by this packet.
recommended_packet_sequence: Compile the focused visual and bot-knowledge requirements.
Apply bounded site and knowledge edits.
Run local tests, screenshots, watchdogs, commit, push, deploy, live smoke.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Resume the shared CRM and channel-assigned communication-agent addendum after deploy proof.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time bot avoid promising portal/member access and make the public landing header, yellow buttons, section spacing, and mobile hero CTA match the current One Time experience better.
raw_quotes: we're not giving access yet to the portal
make the top header the same as when you click on the member section
the yellow buttons are like this black ugly Shadow underneath
get rid of some of the spacing in between
move up the yellow button to call to action under the hero

decisions_captured.decision: The bot may not claim portal, library, member, parent-login, or student-login access is currently being granted.
The public header should visually align with the member-area One Time lockup and black/yellow family.

out_of_scope: No WhatsApp, Telegram, or email send.
No WAPI token, webhook secret, Resend key, or OPENAI_API_KEY change.
No broad CRM or Agents UI completion in this packet.
No contradictory pricing, trial, portal, library, or class-link publication.
affected_surfaces: One Time public acquisition landing page
One Time communication bot knowledge/runtime guardrails

known_current_defects: Public landing header did not use the same One Time member-style black/yellow lockup family.
Yellow CTA buttons used a heavy black slab shadow.
Public landing vertical section spacing needed a small tightening.
The mobile hero signup CTA sat too low relative to bottom browser chrome and the WhatsApp launcher zone.
The bot knowledge still carried stale access-adjacent claims unless guarded by runtime policy.
current_state.after_screenshot_plan: Capture 1440, 1024, 768, 430, and 390 screenshots through the One Time local landing WhatsApp smoke.

trigger_phrases: not giving access yet to the portal

expanded_phrases.ugly: Replace the heavy black slab shadow under yellow CTA buttons with a softer, professional elevation that keeps the yellow/black brand.
expanded_phrases.spacing: Reduce vertical section padding slightly without collapsing content hierarchy or breaking responsive layout.
expanded_phrases.same as member section: Use the One Time member-style brand lockup, black topbar, compact logo tile, and yellow accents on the public header.
expanded_phrases.phone is blocking it: Raise the mobile hero primary signup CTA enough that it does not overlap bottom browser chrome or the WhatsApp launcher.
expanded_phrases.portal: Bot and page copy must not promise portal, member, library, parent-login, or student-login access until separately approved.

product_quality_expansion.user_facing_goal: The One Time public page should feel like the same product family as the member area, with the primary signup CTA readable and reachable on phones.
information_architecture: Keep the public landing as the first screen.
Keep signup as the primary CTA.
Keep member login as navigation, not as a promised access grant.
visible_layout_rules: Desktop shows public section navigation and signup CTA.
Mobile uses the existing drawer control and keeps the signup CTA in the hero clear of the bottom floating launcher.

design_pattern_references: One Time member-area black/yellow header treatment
Existing One Time public brand tokens
Existing One Time mobile drawer behavior

requirements.statement: Update the One Time bot knowledge/runtime so it does not state that portal, member, library, parent-login, or student-login access is available yet.
requirements.expected_result: Program, signup, trial, pricing, portal, and access replies use only approved safe facts and route unknown access questions to a human.
acceptance_criteria: Bot profile marks offer terms as not_published_for_bot.
Runtime does not say 30-day trial or $67 unless future explicit published data exists.
Runtime does not promise portal, member, library, parent-login, or student-login access.
Focused bot tests assert the safe unpublished policy.

requirements.statement: Revise the One Time public landing header, yellow CTA elevation, section rhythm, and mobile hero CTA clearance.
requirements.expected_result: The /one-time header matches the member-style One Time family, CTA shadows are softer, section spacing is tighter, and the mobile hero signup CTA clears the bottom browser and launcher zone.
acceptance_criteria: Header uses a One Time logo lockup, compact black/yellow bar, desktop section navigation, member login link, and signup CTA.
Yellow CTA buttons no longer use a heavy black slab shadow.
Public landing sections have reduced vertical padding while preserving readability.
390px and 430px screenshots prove the hero signup CTA does not overlap the WhatsApp launcher and remains above the bottom safe zone.
Public section navigation action is registered.

criteria: Affected One Time public page, member header reference, bot profile, runtime, tests, and action registry were inspected.
Implementation is limited to one public landing visual slice plus one bot-knowledge guardrail.
External sends, payments, access grants, credentials, CRM broad work, and full communication-agent runtime are explicitly out of scope.
Screenshot proof requirements are defined before closeout.

findings.user_impact: Public header felt disconnected from the member-area One Time family.
findings.expected_fix: Use member-style logo lockup, black/yellow topbar, public section navigation, signup CTA, and member login link.

findings.user_impact: CTA elevation looked too heavy under the yellow brand buttons.
findings.expected_fix: Remove the black slab shadow and keep a softer elevation/glow.

findings.user_impact: Section rhythm had more vertical air than requested for the revised page.
findings.expected_fix: Reduce section and final CTA padding slightly while keeping readable hierarchy.

findings.user_impact: Hero signup CTA could sit too low on phone viewports.
findings.expected_fix: Raise the hero CTA and verify it clears the bottom chrome/launcher zone.
